name: SHIELD remote (2019)
notes: Verified on SHIELD TV Pro 2019, Android 11, SHIELD Experience 9.2.4: NVIDIA's com.nvidia.shieldtech.hooks (NvNetflix) handles BUTTON_12 at interceptKeyBeforeDispatching, after the accessibility filter, so KeyMapService can take it over. The mic key (ASSIST) is handled earlier and cannot be taken this way.

name: Google TV Streamer remote

buttons.name: Home button
buttons.default: Opens the Google TV home (long press: dashboard panel)

notes: Verified on Google TV Streamer (kirkwood, Android 14) 2026-11-02: KeyMapService receives KEYCODE_HOME from this remote (18d1:9451 'Google TV Remote Keyboard') before PhoneWindowManager, so Home can open OmarchyTV without the stock home flashing. Long press: bind to intent:#Intent;action=android.app.action.TOGGLE_NOTIFICATION_HANDLER_PANEL;end for the Google TV dashboard. The mic key is ASSIST (key 217 in Vendor_18d1_Product_9451.kl): Android 14 handles it in interceptKeyBeforeQueueing, before accessibility, so KeyMapService can't take it; instead VoiceSearchActivity holds ACTION_ASSIST and OmarchyTV the Assistant role.
